'''Cassius Nolath Rha''' was a [[Sevari]] [[spice lord]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He governed the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] rich [[Equatorial Belt]] of [[Sevarcos II]]. He was quite trim for his age and, to many, was considered a paragon of health and strength.

==Biography==
[[File:CassiusNolathRhaMountainKeep-Journal2.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Lord Rha's Mountain Keep.]]

===A ruthless ruler===
Cassius Nolath Rha was known for his ruthlessness, owning an impressive [[slave galley]] called the ''[[Andris Moon]]'', which was operated by hundreds of [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. He also had several [[Fortress/Legends|fortresses]], residing in one placed on the border of the [[Northern Frontier]]. Rha commanded a small unit of fanatically-loyal [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] called the [[Spice Blades]], whom he controlled and manipulated, using [[Carsunum/Legends|black spice]].

===Relations with the Empire===
Rha was by far the most powerful spice lord of his time, much to the envy of [[Xerxes Quintas]] and [[Trevael]]&mdash;having cut a profitable deal with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], allowing them to establish space mining prison colonies and mine excessively for spice and paying him a considerable amount of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for it. He would constantly be courting to the Imperial [[planetary commandant]] to maintain his "good" relations with the Empire. In reality, however, he did not care much for the Empire, using it instead as a tool for his own wealth.
